title: Prospective logistic STOP calibration with frozen Direct Horn-rule ranking and grammar-disjoint train/dev/heldout

model.original_checkpoint_source: Exact eight AF23 original SHA256-verified final 6036-parameter ReadoutPolicy('ancestor',4) checkpoint ZIPs from run 43812708916; frozen no weight updates.
frozen_components: two-step original Bellman values for feature generation
model.learned_component: Per-seed 7-parameter L2-regularized logistic STOP gate on six frozen source/public inputs; each seed separately fitted on its only permitted train split, threshold selected only by its dev split
model.no_new_model_training: 0 original checkpoint parameter updates; logistic gate fitted only
model.train_features: [Direct_STOP_minus_best_legal, clipped_root_reach_logit/4, clipped_root_distance_logit/4, VI2_STOP_minus_best_legal/8, (legal_count-4)/4, (known_fact_count-4)/4], each clipped to [-8,8] and train-only standardized
model.feature_eligibility: No exact goal reachability, BFS distance, source case label, layout ID, grammar family, withheld split ID, oracle-optimal actions or source-provided hidden truth is a model input
model.train_loss: Balanced binary cross entropy for STOP=unreachable plus 0.01 L2 slope penalty, deterministic 600 full-batch gradient updates, step 0.1, seed-independent training implementation, no train outcome-based model selection
model.train_examples: Root and two source-independent legal first-rule successor states per train case, chosen by sorted physical rule slot (deduplicate states); exclude goal states and rule-exhausted states from fit; count original cases as statistical units in reporting
model.dev_threshold: Choose from exactly [0.05,0.10,...,0.95] the lowest threshold with >=90% sensitivity for provable DEV roots (continue) maximizing DEV negative correct initial STOP, breaking ties to largest threshold. If none meets floor, use 0.95. Threshold selected once per frozen seed before heldout evaluation, recorded in signed receipt.
model.class_balance: Equal positive/negative class weight, with no per-grammar or per-seed outcome drop
model.regularization: Clip standardized training features to [-8,8] and gradient norm to 10; preregistered coefficients shared across all states of one seed only

cohorts.negative_roots: Replace critical atom2 with one of 7,8,10,11; keep four root facts; require independent closure and BFS certify unprovable
cohorts.case_balance: Two templates per split, each 96 cases with 40 provable and 56 unprovable, shuffled physical atom/rule maps per source-owned case ID; no cross-split hash overlap
cohorts.topology_gate: Different source template canonical logical-incidence signatures across train/dev/held. Heldout templates differ from every train and dev source template by goal-rule arity or productive prerequisite dependency topology, not just physical permutations.
cohorts.max_graph: 15 atoms,14 rule slots,2 goal-concluding rules,4 given atoms, min 2 distinct legal root actions on provable; exact independent BFS on every case
cohorts.predata_gate: Commit source, SHA256 manifest, independent truth/length proof and isolated split topo signature checks before collecting neural features or training STOP gate. Abort on structural failure; all changes become dated amendments before model scoring.

arms.DD: Direct native STOP gate + Direct legal-rule ranking, original frozen checkpoint
arms.VD: VI2 native STOP gate + Direct legal-rule ranking, unchanged frozen checkpoint
arms.CAL: Learned logistic STOP gate, Direct legal-rule ranking, checkpoint frozen
arms.THR: Train/dev-only Direct STOP margin scalar threshold, Direct legal-rule ranking, same dev selection and no logistic
arms.ND: Always continue if legal rule remains, Direct ranking; negative STOP sanity control
arms.CLOSURE: Original source AF24 public closure policy, no learned weights
arms.BFS16: Original source AF24 capped 16 public host state expansions per decision
arms.BFS64: Original source AF24 capped 64 public host state expansions per decision
arms.SHORTEST: Exact shortest proof oracle as heldout upper control only

primary.pass: At BOTH heldout depths, CAL correct initial STOP on negative >= DD+7, CAL completed provable >= DD-4, and zero host accepted false proofs; at least 6/8 fixed original seeds.
primary.control_qualification: Also publish THR against CAL on identical paired cases; if THR equals/exceeds CAL, do not claim a benefit from learning multivariate coefficients. Public closure and BFS controls cap any broader neural proof-search claim.
primary.scientific_scope: Synthetic positive-Horn policy calibration only, no independent autonomous theorem proving claim.

metrics: Per-seed held positive proofs completed and total budget
per-root marginal calibrated probability by truth label
top-legal-rule optimality and native Direct/VI2 margins
per-case paired wins and losses versus DD
symbolic rule examinations and BFS expansions
secondary.calibration: Brier score, negative log loss, expected calibration error 10 equal-width bins on heldout initial root for CAL/DD/VD/THR if probabilities interpretable; DD and VD raw native score margins are not probabilities, so compute Brier only for CAL and THR
secondary.label_separation: Host exact reachability and minimum proof steps allowed only for supervised train/dev labels, held evaluation budget, and independently posthoc analysis. No heldout threshold tuning.
secondary.no_pseudoreplication: Each heldout depth has 80 unique positive +112 unique negative physical graphs, reused over 8 fixed model checkpoints; per-seed paired outputs as well as pooled counts.

audit.experiment_source: Full source SHA256 and frozen graph split manifest checked pretraining and preheldout
audit.original_model: Original 8 SHA256-pinned AF23 checkpoint ZIP archives and members, exact source training receipt and Torch/NumPy parity
audit.heldout: All new neural rollouts use their actual chosen successor states, recomputing calibrated score and original frozen model after each host rule; independent physical Horn proof and score-action reconstruction; independent BFS shortest label only in scorer
audit.calibration: Persist exact feature rows, class labels with train/dev split IDs and coefficient receipt. Independent calculation from source-pinned model forwards samples and derived gradients, threshold selection and dev confusion matrix.
audit.honest_failure: Any missing seed, broken source-identity or audit result leads INCONCLUSIVE; scientific PASS or FAIL requires all 8 source-checked seed results.
audit.original_verdicts: AF22 FAIL, AF23 weak baseline PASS, AF24 SYMBOLIC_CONTROL_MATCH, AF24B transfer FAIL, AF25 no advantage, AF26 RULE_ONLY, AF27 STOP_TRANSFER_FAIL all unchanged.
